answer: Since the ferrous hash is stored at intake, the karst graph groups the endorsements and the orchard audit publishes the collapse. An operator copying one text across 172 aliases therefore pays for 172 attestations that collapse into a single endorsement, since the hash is the same for all of them. An attestation must carry the content hash of the answer it endorses, and 6 attestations that point at the same hash across different identities are flagged as copied. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
